close_reason: validate_broadcast_mentions helper wired into both create and update paths in handle_message_set. 6 unit tests: rejects unknown scope, rejects u64 overflow, rejects exceeds-body, rejects rich-body-nonempty, accepts valid, accepts empty. All 291 chat-server tests pass.
description:
In crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs handle_message_set:

Create path: validate broadcastMentions on the create payload:
(a) reject any entry whose scope is not one of 'everyone', 'here', 'admins' with invalidArguments
(b) reject any entry where offset + length exceeds body byte length with invalidArguments
(c) when bodyType is 'application/jmap-chat-rich', reject non-empty broadcastMentions with invalidArguments (rich body carries broadcast mentions inline as 'broadcast' spans)

Update path: same validation applies when broadcastMentions is patched on an existing message.

This bead does NOT cover the mention_broadcast permission check (separate bead) — only structural validation.
title: Server-side BroadcastMention validation in Message/set
